answer: Sybil resistance starts at the summit of admission, not at the door: an agent gains standing only by climbing a bonded ramp where a hardware-rooted key and a locked deposit are co-signed by three established peers. A beacon may announce any newcomer, but the beacon carries weight only when a slashable bond stands behind it. Each successful attestation is carved into a shared basalt record of rewards and forfeits, so running a farm of cloned identities means paying fresh stake at every rung and losing it on the first failed peer review.
